scope: Independent offline launch review of current packets, provider client, orchestration, execution and scientific analysis gates. This is not scientific validation of author outputs or authentication of original source articles.

tests.scope: Mocked provider usage/pricing, reservation-before-dispatch, budget refusal, no retry, secret redaction, nonexecuting parse, exact ABI, original anchors, lossless source content, prompt boundaries, complete 20-slot plan, stale-review rejection, modified-plan rejection, candidate capture integrity.

Reviewer reran inspected trusted synthetic fixtures: analytic slopes/residual correlation and SD conventions, units, invalid rows, component preservation, rank degeneracy, all60 failure accounting, unchanged sandbox command and closure gates. Worker capture forbidden on control-path tests.

resolved_findings.finding: OpenAI implicit cache writes omitted from normalized usage, tariff calculation and reservation.
resolved_findings.resolution: 30m cache writes normalized, charged at 1.25 times base input and removed from ordinary input; input reserve uses maximum base/write rate; fixture passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial parser allowed variadic and keyword-only ABI.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact synchronous three-positional-argument ABI enforced; negative fixtures pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Existing candidate directories could contain artifacts different from captured API response.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact program bytes, model/task object, decision record and capture binding are checked on reuse; mutation fixture rejected.

resolved_findings.finding: Passing review did not bind reviewed implementation/packet hashes and plan.
resolved_findings.resolution: Freeze requires matching review inventory and run-plan hash; stale-review and changed-plan fixtures rejected.

resolved_findings.finding: Repair reservation overflow did not set batch STOP.
resolved_findings.resolution: Repair overflow now sets STOP as initial overflow does.

resolved_findings.finding: Lipid strict positivity was checked only at analysis after inclusive-minimum schema validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict positive BMI/TC/HDL now required at output validation and successful-receipt verification; zero-TC fixture rejected.

Fable 5.2 adaptive high settings, 8/40/0.20/10 standard and 5m cache prices.

Stable model name, supported high reasoning and context/output limits.
Gemini4 candidate_count removal and nonstreaming 32768 output ceiling.

limitations: This passes the pre-paid-call gate only. Every current output must still be retained, sealed, executed in the approved worker and evaluated after all20 construction and all60 execution outcomes close.
No invoice, quota, remaining account balance or successful model generation is established by offline tests/catalogs. Unknown-cost failures retain conservative reserves.
All provider high settings are native labels, not equal compute. Returned model identity must be reported. DeepSeek tariff estimate is deliberately peak-rate conservative.
Runtime preparation probe checks trusted imports/hashes, not an actual bubblewrap namespace launch. No unrestricted fallback is authorized.
Host hashes are relative integrity commitments, not protection against a trusted host rewriting files and receipts together.

An early broad reviewer-only repository text search returned unrelated historical result snippets. They were not packet inputs, were not transmitted to providers, and did not influence scientific parameter edits. Author API contexts receive only the exact frozen prompt and common system instruction.
Historical references are exposed at project level; this is developmental evaluation, not new clinical confirmation.
